title: What's new in VirtualPyTest: new look, 3 languages, shareable reports, analytics
description:
A quick tour of what's new in VirtualPyTest. The app has a new look: one clean style on every page, in light or dark. It now speaks English, French and German with one click, and so do the test reports. Any report can be shared as a snapshot link that expires, optionally with a password. Anyone with the link sees the report, screenshots and video with no account needed, and one click revokes it. Analytics: ask Atlas for a canvas in one sentence, then open the same panels as a Grafana dashboard already filtered to your device.

Open source & free.
